KJAH01 is the Danish SMR procedure code designating laparoscopy [^src1]. In the context of the Danish quality database for inflammatory bowel diseases (DANIBD), this code is utilized to track surgical interventions and reoperations among IBD patients, which is the primary focus of the database's quality Indicator 6 [^src1]. 

According to appendix table 7 of the 2024 DANIBD report, KJAH01 is the most frequently registered reoperation procedure for IBD [^src1]. Specifically, the reported data shows that laparoscopy was recorded in 20 instances, accounting for 20.4% of the relevant reoperation cohort [^src1]. The systematic tracking of SMR procedure codes like KJAH01 provides a detailed quantitative foundation for quality monitoring, helping to evaluate surgical outcomes and develop treatment standards within Danish IBD care [^src1].
